object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: No test has two rules giving directives for one attribute on one object (the rules in the existing tests never overlap). Rules file: rule 1 type Requirement requires rationale; rule 2 type Requirement and status Approved forbids rationale. (a) Requirement, Approved, with rationale: RULE_FORBIDDEN_PRESENT and no other rule error; (b) Requirement, Approved, without rationale: no rule error; (c) Requirement, Draft, without rationale: RULE_REQUIRED_MISSING. Swap the two rules' order: (a) gives no rule error, (b) gives RULE_REQUIRED_MISSING.
